title: Bills 128 and 129 for countywide water upgrades
summary: On September 29, 2026, Bill 128, which would re-fund $3 million for countywide water upgrades, had its first reading and a vote was taken, though the count is cut off in the recording. The money is being re-funded because last year's funding lapsed. Bill 129 would separately allow a loan from the state's Drinking Water State Revolving Fund for water supply projects.
